product.title: New Orleans Swamp Tour Boat Adventure With Pickup

description.text: Travel from New Orleans to a Louisiana swamp for a narrated boat tour through bayou waterways and wetland scenery. This experience includes selected hotel pickup and drop-off, then continues to the launch area for time on the water with a local captain. The route is water-based rather than a city sightseeing loop, so conditions, wildlife activity, and captain routing shape what guests see during the outing. Expect marsh and cypress landscapes, opportunities for wildlife viewing, and practical transportation logistics suited to travelers who want a swamp experience without arranging a separate drive from New Orleans.

highlights: Round-trip transportation from selected New Orleans pickup locations
Narrated swamp boat tour through Louisiana bayou waterways
Wetland scenery with seasonal opportunities to see local wildlife
Water-based route led by a local captain
